lede: The sharpest item this week is Wednesday's Parks & Recreation Commission meeting, where the already-approved plan to pave Town Park's grass oval for basketball and pickleball courts comes back up — more than 400 signatures and letters of opposition are on the table, so this one has real stakes for the heart of town. The Gondola Leadership Committee also convenes Monday on what's described as a substantive session covering funding commitments and project updates on the longest-running civic question in the valley. And Sunday, the Town Council sits as the Liquor Licensing Authority for a public hearing on KOTO's Live at the Drive permit.
